# OverCue Desktop 2.2.23 for Windows

- Separate stems on PCs with 16 GB of memory: CPU processing now needs about 10 GB that Windows can commit instead of 11 GB of free physical memory, and it uses far less memory between tracks.
- Automatic processor selection uses the CPU instead of DirectML on graphics cards with less than 16 GB of dedicated memory, and Settings shows the reason. Choosing DirectML yourself still runs it, with a warning. NVIDIA cards with 8 GB or more keep using CUDA.
- CPU processing uses every core when no other track is being packaged, so single tracks finish sooner.
- When Windows runs out of memory it can commit, the batch stops with a message that says so instead of an unexplained "stopped".
